title: Gone Fishin' Boat Rentals

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Reservations required, minimum of 3 consecutive days required. Renters must have boating experience. Boating safety and operators’ skills/experience operating in the ocean are required to rent. The 22′ Wooldridge is set up to fish and seat 4 people. (5 people maximum occupancy) The War Wagon has a 300 hp Suzuki main engine and a 9.9 hp Suzuki trolling

blurb: We are a family owned and operated boat rental company in Ketchikan, Alaska. We are here to help you with all your boat rental needs. Whether you want to be out fishing the Salmon Capital Of The World, targeting possible world record halibut and other bottom fish or simply taking in the breath taking views from whales reaching for the skies, seals playing on the waves or Orcas patrolling the areas. Ketchikan has it
